notes: Source paintings for the image-to-3D step. Save each as <name>.png (1024x1024), run image-to-3D, export the FULL-DETAIL glb as the target path (games/<slug>/models/<item>.glb); the lite copy is made by us. Light-grey background on purpose: the 3D step removes it and a green background would tint the model colours. Keys are <slug>--<item>. Where "ref" is set, an existing painting of the same thing is in the repo: use it as the image-to-image reference for the same look.
